body.baselineNote: Baseline shorter than the WMO 30-year standard (1981–2010 data not available).

kpis.label: Peak Flow (Qmax)
kpis.sublabel: derived, highest daily mean flow, 23 Feb 2026
kpis.methodNote: Derived: the highest daily mean flow, runoff depth × the district's real area ÷ 86 400 s (mm × km² × 1000 m³). A modelled daily mean, not an instantaneous peak; the table's own peak column is withheld (scaled to 6 500 km²).

kpis.label: Baseflow Index
kpis.sublabel: Σ baseflow / Σ total flow, 12 months

kpis.label: Districts with Normal Flow
kpis.sublabel: derived, between own Q90 and Q10 (2000–2025), Aug 2026, of 52
kpis.methodNote: Derived: a district's monthly mean flow (runoff depth × real area) above its own Q10 (flow exceeded 10 % of months) is high, below its own Q90 is low, otherwise normal; thresholds from the district's complete months of the full years since 2000. Modelled flow per district, not gauged stations.

kpis.label: Districts with Low Flow
kpis.sublabel: derived, below own Q90 (2000–2025), Aug 2026, of 52
kpis.methodNote: Derived: a district's monthly mean flow (runoff depth × real area) above its own Q10 (flow exceeded 10 % of months) is high, below its own Q90 is low, otherwise normal; thresholds from the district's complete months of the full years since 2000. Modelled flow per district, not gauged stations.
